Nina (CS): Heads-up: QBR for Meridian Health next Wed. They've doubled embedding volume after a new search UX. Need a tight token forecast + a mitigation checklist for renewal.
Jamal (FinOps): I will produce a 3-scenario CSV (baseline, commit-optimistic, burst-99) split by route. ETA today.
Pri (Onboarding): They enabled client batching but no server prefix cache. Quick win: enable prefix keys by customer namespace to cut duplicate calls. I can draft the steps.
Theo (Eval): If we suggest embed-mid-quant for background indexing, I can run a 50-query tolerability check. Will report recall@10 and sample diffs.
Sofia (AM): Customer wants predictable spend and a 12-month commit option. They accept up to 8% embedding recall drop for non-customer-facing flows. No quality loss on chat.
Nina (CS): Alerts: can we get a soft warning at 60% of proposed commit and an emergency rule at 95% that auto-routes 10% traffic to a lower-cost embed?
alerts-bot: Soft alert "Meridian_warn_60" created -> notifies #cs-ops + sofia@redwood.com. Emergency rule "Meridian_emergency_95" will auto-route 10% of embedding traffic to embed-mid-quant.
Jamal (FinOps): Sample CSV head:
route,30d_tokens,baseline_monthly,commit_60M,commit_120M,99pct_tail
embeddings,45,42000000,36000000,30000000,68000000
chat,7,9000000,8500000,8000000,15000000
(Full CSV in GDrive.)
Pri (Onboarding): Ops snippet for slide: "If monthly spend > 85% and error-rate < 1%, enable 10% fallback to embed-mid-quant and notify AM/CS; verify cache hit rate post-change."
Theo (Eval): Headline: quantized embed reduces embedding cost ~25% with median recall drop ~5% on our dev set; recommend staged rollout for background jobs only. Will drop eval doc link shortly.
Sofia (AM): I'll present commit tiers and propose a rollback clause: auto-rollback if customer-facing recall drops >10% for two consecutive weeks.
Nina (CS): Action items: Jamal -> full CSV; Pri -> prefix-cache steps + canary config; Theo -> eval doc; Sofia -> term outline. I'll assemble slides and post draft in #qbr-deck by EOD. :thumbsup:
